name: Fade an 08:25-09:25 volume-shock minute, exit after 120 min
why: A data-release minute that trades 5x normal volume is mostly stops and algos chasing the print; the larger participants fade the overshoot over the next hour (event study 2026-10-19: -0.025 ATR at 60 min, -0.040 at 120, all eras).
